Simulate a reduced manuscript-style MBMM dataset

Source: R/simulation-demo.R
mbmm_simulate_manuscript_demo.Rd

This public simulation preserves the main manuscript structure while replacing private empirical biomarker and visit-pattern inputs with fully synthetic analogues.

Usage

mbmm_simulate_manuscript_demo(
  n_subjects = 50,
  prevalence = 0.3,
  beta_true = -1.5,
  p_abortive = 0.4,
  n_bank_donors = 8L,
  productive_parameter_bank = NULL,
  visit_schedules = mbmm_demo_visit_schedules(),
  sigma_obs = 0.5,
  lod = 100,
  productive_min_detect = 1L,
  productive_max_tries = 50L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_subjects

Number of subjects.

prevalence

Target marginal productive-infection prevalence for the realized synthetic biomarker distribution.

beta_true

True standardized biomarker effect in the logistic gate. Negative values represent protection.

p_abortive

Probability that a nonproductive subject receives an abortive/transient pattern rather than a purely near-background trajectory.

n_bank_donors

Number of productive subjects assigned the complete visit schedule and flagged as bank eligible.

productive_parameter_bank

Optional data frame of productive ODE parameters. When omitted, a synthetic public bank is generated from mbmm_example_eclipse_prior.

visit_schedules

Named list of public visit schedules.

sigma_obs

Observation-noise SD on the log10 scale.

lod

Natural-scale assay limit of detection.

productive_min_detect

Minimum number of detections requested for a productive trajectory.

productive_max_tries

Maximum attempts used to obtain that minimum.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A list with:

subject_data

Subject-level covariates and truth.

truth

Alias of subject_data.

observations

Long-format observations.

obs_list

Named per-subject observation data frames.

covariates

Data frame containing id and baseline_antibody.

productive_parameter_bank

Parameter bank used for productive trajectory generation.

settings

Generating settings.

Details

Productive subjects are generated from mbmm_example_eclipse_simulate using parameter draws from mbmm_example_eclipse_prior unless a custom productive parameter bank is supplied.
